name: cta-close
description: A display-scale action line lands per word and fills the frame with air, one generous CTA capsule pops beneath it with a single overshoot, and the finished close holds completely still.

vars.description: Two to four word action that closes the film.
Text displayed inside the single CTA capsule.
Contract color used by the CTA capsule.
Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts (this primitive closes films).
